title: Publish the current website version

requirements.text: Trigger a build and publish/release of the current app version using the existing publishing flow, so the latest changes (including the GIF media updates already implemented) are deployed and available in the preview/production environment.
acceptanceCriteria: A new build is created from the current codebase state without requiring additional code changes.
The deployed/published version reflects the latest frontend assets and pages already updated (e.g., Home/Hero and Services GIF usage).
No regressions: the site loads successfully and key pages render without runtime errors after publishing.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; add backend/migration.mo only if a state migration is required.
nonGoals: Changing which pages/components use GIFs (Home/Hero, Services) beyond what is already implemented.
Adding new features unrelated to publishing/deployment.
